newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM, MAS Emirates eye Dubai cargo hub.
newsitem.headline: KLM, MAS Emirates eye Dubai cargo hub.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV Cargo along with Emirates and Malaysia Airlines System Bhd are studying the possible development of a Dubai freight hub, a KLM Cargo spokesman said.
He added that Dubai is already recognised by the Dutch airline as a very important cargo transfer point.
"This is related to our network philosophy. We are now looking at what we can offer our customers by combining forces," he told Reuters.
He could not state whether the three airlines will develop their own separate hub in Dubai and said the project is only under consideration at this stage.
An Emirates spokesman in Dubai declined to comment on the report.
Germany's Lufthansa Cargo AG has one of its main hubs at Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
